'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Xuanfang Warden found in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Shuoyan:''' Wait—hey! Could you be—
:'''Shuoyan:''' H-hello! I mean... sorry, I-I...

==Dialogue==
:'''Shuoyan:''' Wait—hey! Could you be—
:'''Shuoyan:''' H-hello! I mean... sorry, I-I...
:'''{{Rover}}:''' Are you talking to me?
:'''Shuoyan:''' Yes! I mean—no offense—but is it true you fought in the Norfall Barrens alongside General Jiyan?
:'''{{Rover}}:''' I did.
:'''Shuoyan:''' Amazing! My friends in the Midnight Rangers have told me about your remarkable deeds. You do have an incredible aura.
:'''Shuoyan:''' I'm a new recruit here in the Xuanfang Warden, and to be honest... I'm still pretty nervous. Do you have any advice for me?
:'''{{Rover}}:''' Trust your companions and trust yourself. Trust the hard work that brought you this far.
:'''Shuoyan:''' Trust... I see. I'll try my best! Thank you so much!
----
;After {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}
:'''Shuoyan:''' Hey, {{Rover}}! I'm Shuoyan, remember?
:'''Shuoyan:''' Your fight against the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion was absolutely breathtaking!
:'''Shuoyan:''' Honestly, I was still a little confused even after your advice.
:'''Shuoyan:''' But the moment I stood on that field with my comrades at my back, I finally understood what your words meant.
:'''Shuoyan:''' The bonds of trust forged in the thick of it... You never forget it.
{{Dialogue End}}
